# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Only the current `master` branch is actively supported for security updates and IAM audits.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a security vulnerability or configuration flaw within this platform architecture, please DO NOT open a public issue. 

Instead, send an email directly to the Platform Architect at prasannadatabuss@gmail.com. He will triage the issue and patch the Terraform blueprint within 24 hours.
